title: Remote-viewed 'alien bases' turned out to be over-the-horizon radar sites

tellings.quote:

I drew them back then were classified so
I could never talk about them publicly

related.note: Both are about McMoneagle remote viewing the supposed alien mountain bases that Pat Price named. Here he says they were over-the-horizon radar sites, not alien command centers.

plain: Three sites that some people call alien bases are, by one account, really over-the-horizon radar stations, a kind of long-range military radar. A man named Joe McMoneagle, who did remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe distant places with the mind alone, tells Michels he drew all three. He says they were classified then, so he told only the people who gave him the task what they were, and he can say it now because it is publicly known.
